title: Eine informationstheoretische Ungleichung und ihre Anwendung auf den Beweis der Ergodizität von Markoffschen Ketten
venue: A Magyar Tudományos Akadémia Matematikai Kutató Intézetének Közleményei 8(1-2):85-108
annotation: Proves that general information divergences cannot increase through a stochastic channel. The joint panel theorem uses this data-processing principle after comparing the hidden Markov path with the iid stationary path.

authors: Nettasinghe, B., Chatterjee, S., Tipireddy, R. and Halappanavar, M.
title: Extending conformal prediction to hidden Markov models with exact validity via de Finetti's theorem for Markov chains
venue: Proceedings of the 40th International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 202:25890-25903
annotation: Conformal prediction for observations driven by a hidden Markov chain, with exact marginal validity from a block-randomization that restores exchangeability; the pooled-residual page quantifies instead the conditional error of the ordinary pooled threshold.

authors: Chernozhukov, V., Wüthrich, K. and Zhu, Y.
title: Exact and robust conformal inference methods for predictive machine learning with dependent data
venue: Proceedings of the 31st Conference on Learning Theory, PMLR 75:732-749
annotation: Conformal inference for time series through block permutations, exact under a block-exchangeability condition and approximately valid under mixing; the dependence between calibration residuals is the effect it addresses.

authors: Oliveira, R. I., Orenstein, P., Ramos, T. and Romano, J. V.
title: Split conformal prediction and non-exchangeable data
annotation: Bounds the marginal coverage gap of split conformal prediction under stationary beta-mixing data in terms of the mixing coefficients and the calibration size; the fast-regime pages give the same gap exactly for a finite chain.

title: Fourier analysis of distribution functions: A mathematical study of the Laplace-Gaussian law
annotation: Develops the Fourier method behind central-limit refinements for lattice laws, including the discontinuous lattice correction represented here by the half-integer tail coordinate.

authors: Datta, S. and McCormick, W. P.
title: On the first-order Edgeworth expansion for a Markov chain
annotation: Establishes a first-order Edgeworth expansion for sums related to a homogeneous Markov chain and corrects inaccuracies in earlier Markov-chain formulations.
